name: Leader Alta
win: “You climbed higher than I thought. The Flying Badge is yours.”
lose: “Gravity always wins. Come back when you can fly.”
hint: Leader Alta’s Flying team is level 36–37. Electric and Steel moves knock Flying Billies out of the sky.

seat.title: Flying Badge · 4 of 8
seat.rewardText: 2 Revives, 3 Gold Pyramids and a Capstone
seat.unlockText: Your team can now take on the island leader in Palmhaven Town, across the sea from Marigold Town.

script: [happy] Welcome to the top. The air is thin and so is my patience. #l:af12
My Flying team has never once looked down. #l:a613
